app.name: Phonetic Word Replicator
app.tagline: Train your ear, master your spelling — one sound at a time.

home.heroIntro: See (or hear) a pronunciation, spell the word it belongs to. Three attempts per word, colour-coded history, and rewards that keep you coming back.
home.rule1: You are shown a word's phonetic transcription — spell the word.
home.rule2: Three attempts per word: blue for first-try, yellow for second, red for third.
home.rule3: Hints reveal letters, but every 3 hints cost the same as one miss.
home.rule4: Correct answers earn XP. Combos, streaks and 16 achievements await.
home.ttsNo: No pronunciation voice found for this language

classic.name: Classic Spelling
classic.tagline: Read the phonetic sound, type the word. The original challenge.

choice.name: Multiple Choice
choice.tagline: Four options, one right sound-match. Warm up gently.

listen.name: Listen & Spell
listen.tagline: No symbols — just your ears. The word is spoken aloud.

speed.name: Speed Challenge
speed.tagline: 60 seconds. Combos up to x3. Chase your best score.

daily.name: Daily Challenge
daily.tagline: 10 seeded words — the same puzzle for everyone, every day.

review.name: Review
review.tagline: Your wobbly words come back until they stick.

settings.title: Settings
settings.matchingHint: Lenient mode accepts 'cafe' for 'café'. Strict mode demands the accent.
settings.pinyinHint: When on, typing the pinyin (e.g. 'ma') counts as correct for Chinese words. Characters always count — this never penalizes native spelling.
